description_en: Calls GetBalanceTrafficData to query billing bandwidth details
description_zh: 调用GetBalanceTrafficData获取账单带宽详情
name: GetBalanceTrafficData

parameters.help_en:
The time granularity of the queried data. Supported values: 300, 3600, 14400, 28800, and 86400 seconds.

If this parameter is not specified or the specified value is not supported, the default value of 300 seconds is used
parameters.help_zh:
查询数据的时间粒度，支持300、3600、14400、28800和86400秒。

当不传该参数和所传的值不支持时，使用默认值300秒
parameters.name: data_interval

parameters.help_en: The resource ID of the current bill
parameters.name: resource_id
